Fictional Foreign Cloud reports first quarter 2026 financial results

Amsterdam — Fictional Foreign Cloud N.V. today announced its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026.

Revenue grew more than fourfold year over year as new data centers came online for AI customers.

About Fictional Foreign Cloud

Fictional Foreign Cloud N.V. is an invented AI infrastructure company used to test this site; it builds and runs data centers in Europe and the United States and rents GPU capacity to developers.
